items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Because cousin Walter worked there. Walter Bell worked there during that time. He was chef there.

ctx.x: You say, did he play with your... Who's that? Did he play with your husband too?

Did he? Oh, yeah. Played at some of them nightclubs together. Because I just can't play this thing. I played at the bungalow. He played at the roadhouse. He played out there. For the Cadillac. At the Cadillac. He played for that man that we called the Marmalade. It was one of them big nightclubs out there by the French market. That one had to live for me. At Lannasa. Lannasa's place. Because cousin Walter worked there. Walter Bell worked there during that time. He was chef there. that was another place you got
